title: Long thread: open and scroll
description: Each process is a fresh launch of P1 on the control session and visits the long thread twice: a first visit and a return, each a list-walk step from the control session to the long thread, the next row down. After each open settles, 20 trusted wheel events of -480 CSS px, 50 ms apart, over the transcript's centre scroll toward older content while an in-page recorder logs every animation frame from the first wheel to 500 ms after the last. The framework re-derives the long-frame count and the p95 frame interval from that log.

metrics.description: Trusted pointerdown on the long thread's list entry to its settle under settle-31-frames.
Animation-frame intervals longer than 33.4 ms, two missed 60 Hz frames, from the first trusted wheel event to 500 ms after the last.
Nearest-rank p95 of the animation-frame intervals in the same window.
